conclusions.outcome: Technical completion, ten arms reached768, all saved model/master/optimizer states finite. No learned promotion: all ten selected step0, recomposition identical to incumbent; stress66/72 unchanged from41u, same six failures.
conclusions.regressions: No acquired regression in retained model:528/528 trajectories; matched responses336/336; original primary330/336 retained. Trained development regressions excluded before stress/native evaluation. Nap-z local at256 rescues2 but breaks1:138/144 vs incumbent137/144, therefore rejected.
conclusions.supervision_locality: Neither direct raw-logit supervision nor existing local correction bank produced an eligible improvement within768 updates. K direct-global768 preserves137/144 but target timing margin worsens; local K also preserves counts but worsens margin. This does not rule out other optimization/data/representation choices.
conclusions.causal: Canonical GPU probes:control66, K-u12=69, Nap-u8=64, Nap-z9=65, jointNap-u8/z9=68, combined=71/72. Joint/combined have no new stress failures. Remaining seed43 staircase K_Pst offset0.4ms exceeds unchanged0.3ms. Earlier41u K oracle70 used paired offlineFP64 recurrence, not bitwise canonical GPU: do not conflate the two.
conclusions.local_bound: On preregistered voltage anchors, required Nap-u8 residual exceeds existing local bound in17.24%-21.68% of anchors depending modelseed; Nap-z9 in2.93%-8.30%. K-u12 has no anchor outside bound. This proves a range limitation for full anchor-curve matching, not that this alone causes all task failures or all relevant-path errors.
conclusions.speed: No new speedup: selected learned arms are bit-identical incumbent. Integrated medians(ms)41u->41v:batch1 94.117->94.077;642 213.547->214.311;4096 673.333->666.481. Inter-run differences are not an introduced algorithmic speedup. All per-arm paired timings preserved in cost observations.
conclusions.pause: User requested record audit then wait. No next task, training, provider run, selection or threshold/abstraction change authorized by this audit.

limitations: Opened diagnostic stress, not independent confirmation. Development41u and41v use different inputs/denominators. Stress/native/cost results concern selected checkpoints (all fallback0), not every trained intermediate. No proof of exhausted optimization or impossible learnability. Teacher probes nonselectable. Original FP32 failed controls218/234 and primary330/336 retained. No Task42 or qualified speedup.
